name: Proof moment miner
description: When pull requests merge into your default branch, it reads each merged PR — diff, description, linked issues — and judges whether the change is genuinely demoable to developers who use coding agents. When one clears the proof bar it drafts a file under docs/marketing/proof-moments/ with the proof-moment description, a draft X post, and a 60-second demo script. Most merges produce nothing, by design. Drafts only: it never posts anywhere.
limitations: There is no direct merged-PR event kind, so it watches default-branch pushes (github:main-updated) and resolves the merged PRs from each push; direct pushes without a PR are ignored. Needs the gh CLI signed in. Output is markdown drafts inside the workspace only — a human reviews, records the demo, and posts.
